title: Rose Revival Legacy
description: Brings back the rose to legacy minecraft!
body:
# Rose Revival Legacy
Brings back the rose into Minecraft 1.7.x - 1.12.x!

‎ 
### PSA to mod/resourcepack creators
Please only list your project under the versions you know work. There are many mods similar to this one that claim to support 1.12.x and below but do not. That is why i created this mod.
